Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Zelen Greleth: 39-year-old woman, 182 cm (tall), clearly muscular construction with readable shoulders, back, legs, and forearms, skin value band-1-lightest. Face: angular diamond face; deep-set eyes and a heavy level brow; prominent bridge, compact mouth; subtle age lines. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: gray-white-silver, short-textured-crop, deliberate accent: sculptural fringe. Wardrobe: mantle-short-cape, specifically a small mantle or short cape over an unarmored tunic and divided lower layers; visible hand repairs and contrasting inner edges; bounded palette rust-charcoal. Visible personal details: one wide engraved hair cuff on one side, with no other hair or ear jewelry. Make one clasp, buckle, piercing, or piece of hair hardware the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: immaculate clothes over weathered hands. Color treatment: lets faded and repaired areas vary the palette. Pose cue: one thumb hooks lightly beneath the waist wrap while the other hand rests open. Include a worn spool of colored thread only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.
